pages.text:
Pulls dropped items within its range into an 18-slot buffer with FE and sends them out through its Output faces (Tempered tier).
- Range is a cube 5 blocks out in each direction; set 1 to 9 with the − and + buttons. The range shows as an outline while you hold a Vacuum Collector, or with the eye button in its GUI.
- Put a Conduit Filter in its filter slot to pick only certain items (set the filter up on a conduit first). Without one, it takes everything.
- Takes Speed and Energy upgrades.
- It also gathers experience orbs into a Liquid Experience tank (16,000 mB) that fluid conduits drain from its Output faces.
